record.question: Thomas Bach is the President of which committee?
record.explanation: IOC election records identify Thomas Bach as its ninth president elected 10 September 2013; he therefore held this office at the January 2015 exam. This is a historical answer, not a current-president claim. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://library.olympics.com/digitalCollection/DigitalCollectionAttachmentDownloadHandler.ashx?documentId=619620&parentDocumentId=167181&skipCopyright=true&skipWatermark=true Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
